# Kaizen journal

One entry per file: `YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>.md`. There is no index — `ls` is the
index, and `grep -h '^# ' */*.md` lists every title.

Entry format, when to write, and the scope boundary: [`../README.md`](../README.md).

Cite task briefs, problem records, and kaizen patterns by backticked slug, with
the type and repository where needed to identify them; never link to their
paths. Links to journal evidence remain real links and protect those entries
from deletion. The shared guide linked through the parent README owns
**Journal citations and one-time adoption**, including the explicit migration
exception for existing entries. After adoption, entries stay unchanged when
those documents move or retire.
